correctness.rationale: Heawood H is the Fano point–line incidence graph on 14 vertices (p·ell=0 over F2 for nonzero 3-bit vectors); K=Ind(H) has 457 nonempty simplices and face counts (14,70,154,147,56,14,2). Independent mod-two chain boundary rank code checked ALL 2,002 nine-vertex induced K[W] and ALL 1,001 ten-vertex supports: H̃3 over F2 vanishes for every size 9, while exactly 21 size-10 supports have H̃3 dimension 1. Supports of smaller cardinality map into some size-9 subcomplex, and vanish rationally since rank over Q >= rank over F2; this establishes the sharp rational inclusion cutoff. Independently identified the 21 complements as two Fano points plus the two lines incident to neither. Source verifier, inspected in full, constructs an ambient acyclic 225-pair Morse matching with six 3-cells, 21 local 69-pair matchings (each one critical vertex and one 3-cell), mod-two cycles surviving ambient 4-boundaries of rank 44, and a quotient spanning rank gain of exactly six. Independent chain enumeration also reproduced the ambient boundary rank 44 and rank-gain 6; the 21 local certificates use the inspected source proof, not a second standalone rerun. Source integral Morse homotopy gives each K[W]≃S3; mod-two nonzero inclusion between free integral H3 groups forces nonzero rational image; rank gain gives rational span. GL3(F2) transitive on unordered point pairs. Hochster’s formula gives β_{6,10}=21. No claim of saturated Z-span.
